title: Welcome Compass: adaptive micro-guides for tenant warm-start
text:
Welcome Compass: adaptive micro-guides for tenant warm-start

description:
Design and prototype an adaptive in-product onboarding layer called 'Welcome Compass' that surfaces 3 contextual micro-guides for new tenants: (1) Quick sandbox (playground snippets + cost preview), (2) Fast rollout checklist (canary -> A/B guardrails), (3) Cost-first tuning tips (batching, KV cache, quant profiles). The layer should appear on first sign-in, be dismissible, and reappear via a dedicated 'Compass' launcher in the Console header. Must be lightweight, non-blocking, and measurable via existing analytics hooks.

acceptance_criteria:
Three micro-guides built in Figma with screen flows for empty state, mid-journey, and re-launch from header
In-product prototype (Figma + clickable) demonstrating tooltip sequencing, adaptive branching (based on detected tenant signals like usage level or Dedicated flag), and cost preview microcard
Design tokens and component spec for one reusable 'guide card' and 'compact checklist' variant documented in the design system (link in attachments)
Copy vetted by PM and Legal for non-confusing cost language; two tone variations tested in usability sessions
Handoff-ready assets and a short implementation RACI with ENG and PM (includes analytics events to fire for progress and dismissal)
Performance guardrails documented: initial overlay payload < 80KB and must not block main console render

comments:
2025-01-20 — Aisha Patel: Initial framing + goals posted. Hypothesis: a 10% increase in first-week sandbox runs will reduce time-to-first-API-call.
2025-01-28 — Marin Cho: Shared early sketches (Fig link) showing 'compass' icon in header that expands to 3 tiles. Asking ENG for constraints on header real estate.
2025-02-02 — Diego Morales (Eng): Header slot OK. We recommend lazy-loading the guide assets and gating cost preview calls to user interaction to avoid extra API load.
2025-02-04 — PM review (Noah Kim): Requested changes to micro-guide order for enterprise tenants (rollout checklist should surface first when Dedicated=true). Added label 'enterprise-flow'.
2025-02-09 — Usability notes (session n=6): Participants liked inline cost preview but found the first card too text-heavy; shortened CTA, added 'try in sandbox' micro-action.
2025-02-11 — Accessibility review (Lara Singh): Contrast and focus order pass for cards; recommend aria-live for dynamic progress updates.
